newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn called down 1/2 to one cent on weather.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn called down 1/2 to one cent on weather.

text.p: CBOT corn futures were expected to open 1/2 to one cent lower Wedensday on forecasts for warmer and drier weather next week, traders said.
"The weather is supposed to be better for the weekend and next week, which is bearish for corn and beans," said a floor trader.
Ideas that the corn market is slightly overbought following a late rally on Tuesday could also contribute to a weak opening, traders said.
In overnight trade on Project A, corn futures settled down 1-1/2 to 1/2 cent per bushel.
